skills.name: Leave It to Hatsuho!
skills.description: Uses kagura forms to cast positive effects on allies.  *HP +300% (10 sec) *Area Physical DEF +25000 (10 sec) *Reflects 70% of incoming skill damage as physical damage (10 sec)

skills.name: Ceremonial Hammer!
skills.description: Swings her mallet around while enveloped in a pillar of flame, inflicting harmful effects on enemies.  *ATK per sec x 300% Area Damage (10 sec) *Enemy Evade Rate -40% (10 sec) *Enemy Hit Rate -25% (10 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Sakura Wars
abilities.description: Sakura Wars Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)
